description: Public Safety Minister Gary Anandasangaree faced pointed questions Tuesday about why the federal government has deported one Iranian official, despite longstanding concerns about how the regime operates in Canada and abroad.
title: Minister pressed why just 1 Iranian official deported after 24 deemed part of terror group

description: The Swiss Consulate General in Vancouver has confirmed the three people killed in Sunday's avalanche in northern B.C. were Swiss nationals. They were part of a group of four that was heli-skiing on Mount Knauss, about 30 kilometres north of Terrace.
title: Trio of Swiss nationals identified as victims in B.C. avalanche

description: OpenAI is shutting down its social media app Sora, which went viral last fall as a place to share short-form videos generated by artificial intelligence, but also raised alarms in Hollywood and beyond about the dangers of letting people create AI videos that resulted in nonconsensual images and realistic deepfakes.
title: OpenAI shuts down Sora app amid rising concerns about deepfakes and consent

description: Antoine Forest, a 30-year-old man from Coteau-du-Lac, Que., was one of two pilots who died in the crash at New York’s LaGuardia airport on Sunday night.
title: Hometown of Quebec pilot killed in LaGuardia plane crash feels his loss

description: Pride festivals are seeking $3 million annually from Ottawa to fill a funding gap left by corporations pulling back funding amid a backlash to diversity, equity and inclusion programs.
title: Pride festivals seek $3M from Ottawa as corporate sponsors pull back amid DEI backlash

description: Known for her field-side reporting on the Toronto Blue Jays, Mae wrote the book Before I Let You Go, which is set to release on Nov. 10.
title: Blue Jays sportscaster Hazel Mae to publish memoir this fall

description: Canada is temporarily halting removals to several more Middle East countries due to "volatile and unpredictable conditions" caused by the U.S.-Israel war with Iran that has spread to surrounding nations.
title: Canada pauses removals of inadmissible individuals to several Middle East countries

description: Jenna Benchetrit's face and name have been used in fake CBC articles intended to scam people into sending money. She’s the senior business writer for CBC News.
title: Fact check: Fake CBC articles use this business writer’s byline

description: Epic Games will cut more than 1,000 jobs following a drop in engagement for Fortnite, the latest layoffs in the video game industry where growth has stalled due to economic uncertainty.
title: Epic Games to lay off more than 1,000 employees as Fortnite usage drops

description: Porter Airlines plans to launch a dozen routes this summer from the overhauled Montreal Metropolitan Airport, as Canada's third-largest carrier seeks to gain purchase in the competitive domestic market and start putting its half-billion-dollar investment to work.
title: Porter to launch flights from revamped Montreal Metropolitan Airport

description: The WNBA board of governors unanimously ratified the terms of a new collective bargaining agreement on Tuesday.
title: WNBA and players unanimously approve agreement, setting up sprint to May season opener

description: The anniversary special, which started streaming Tuesday on Disney+ and Hulu, celebrates 20 years since the show's premiere. Filmed in front of a live audience, it features archival footage and is centred on an interview with MileyCyrus — now 33 and a genuine pop star — with podcast host Alex Cooper.
title: The Best of Both Worlds? Miley Cyrus back as Hannah Montana in new anniversary special

description: Israel will occupy southern Lebanon up to the Litani River to create a "defensive buffer," Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Tuesday, spelling out for the first time Israel's i
title: Israel's defence minister says military plans occupy swathe of southern Lebanon

description: A man who slipped and fell between 100 and 150 metres while trying to help a companion during a hike on one of the tallest mountains in Metro Vancouver's North Shore has died of his injuries.
title: Hiker dies after slipping down B.C.'s Brunswick Mountain while trying to help companion

description: Justice Minister Sean Fraser says he has no plans to change how judges are appointed in Canada after four premiers wrote to Prime Minister Mark Carney asking for more of a say in the process.
title: Justice minister won't meet premiers' demand for 'sea change' to how judges are appointed

description: An RCMP-led corruption investigation is underway and search warrants were executed on a number of properties, including the homes of former mayor Jyoti Gondek, former councillor Sean Chu and sitting councillor Andre Chabot.
title: RCMP probe corruption allegations at Calgary city hall; warrants executed on former mayor, councillors

description: An 18-year-old man has been charged with second-degree murder in a deadly daytime shooting on a highway south of Edmonton.
title: 18-year-old man charged with 2nd-degree murder in Alberta highway shooting

description: A House of Commons committee is calling on the government to make changes to federal election rules it says would make it harder for electoral reform advocates to stage long ballot protests.
title: To stop long ballot protests, MP committee calls on government to change candidacy rules

description: The federal minimum wage will rise by 40 cents next week, a scheduled increase that keeps the wage in line with inflation.
title: Federal minimum wage increasing to $18.15 per hour

description: A commission studying the future of sport in Canada has called for sweeping change to the way sport is structured, after its work found “the widespread presence of maltreatment and abuse” in a poorly resourced and organized system.
title: ‘Fragmented, inconsistent, unsafe': Commission calls for sweeping change to sport in Canada

description: A huge heat dome is spreading across the United States. After breaking March records in 14 states with temperatures as high as 44.4 C, it's now widening and may become the most expansive heat dome ever.
title: Record-breaking heat dome growing to cover nearly the entire U.S.

description: A social media post by Dion herself and the new posters across Paris are fueling speculation about the singer's reported return to performing. But representatives for the Quebec star have not confirmed any performances.
title: Mysterious posters hinting at Céline Dion's rumoured return pop up in Paris

description: Ottawa police have arrested a 19-year-old man after a school crossing guard died following a hit-and-run collision near a Barrhaven elementary school on Monday.
title: Arrest made in hit and run that killed Ottawa school crossing guard

description: A county sheriff's office in Maryland said Monday that professional cornhole player who's also a quadruple amputee fatally shot a passenger in the front seat of a car he was driving during an argument.
title: Quadruple amputee cornhole player accused of fatally shooting man in Maryland

description: The Trump administration will pay $1 billion to a France's TotalEnergies to walk away from two U.S. offshore wind leases as the administration ramps up its campaign against offshore wind and other renewable energy.
title: U.S. to pay French company $1B to scrap offshore wind projects

description: Canada’s largest AI data centre starts construction this spring in Saskatchewan. It’s one of many being built and proposed across the country. Today, a look at these centres’ controversial track record.
title: The true cost of AI data centres

description: Much of Newfoundland is waking up to blustery and messy morning that has shuttered schools as another storm slams into the island.
title: ‘A messy day ahead’ as another winter storm keeps some Newfoundland schools closed

description: The City of St. John's has killed thousands of gulls at the Robin Hood Bay landfill as part of its wildlife management plan, but some critics say the city is taking the wrong approach.
title: St. John's airport has a seagull problem. But critics say more than a decade of culls hasn't made things safer
How RCMP spies infiltrated the 1970s Indigenous rights movement

description: Rhetoric around Iranian sleeper cells has spiked since the onset of the U.S.-Israel war with Iran. Counter-intelligence experts and a former spy tell CBC News that while the regime may not use dormant agents in Canada, the threats of lone wolf attacks and 'criminal proxies' are real.
title: Are Iranian 'sleeper cells' a threat to Canadians? Here’s what intelligence experts say

description: Six years after the Ontario government made e-learning a mandatory requirement for a high school diploma, students don't appear to be taking online school to diversify their course selection as the province had intended, according to a CBC News analysis of provincial enrolment data.
title: Ontario mandated e-learning to expand course options. Some worry it's being used to boost marks

description: The first set of deadlines included in the energy and climate deal struck between Prime Minister Mark Carney and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith are not expected to be met, showing early challenges with the agreement that includes pursuing a new export pipeline from Alberta to the West Coast.
title: Smith-Carney pipeline deal to miss early deadlines, premier says

description: More than 125,000 people have crossed from Lebanon into Syria this month, fleeing escalating violence and returning to a country that's still struggling to rebuild after more than a decade of civil war.
title: Syrians fleeing Israeli strikes in Lebanon return home to a country still rebuilding

description: When the owner of a Byron pizzeria got hit with negative comments in a suspected "review bomb" members of the community countered with a review bomb of their own, this time with positive feedback.
title: When a beloved pizza joint got bombarded with 1-star Google reviews, a London, Ont., neighbourhood fought back
